metadata.description: pm: a Claude Code plugin that takes a product manager from public evidence to a selected opportunity, a clickable prototype, and an engineering-ready PRD on a real open-source product, plus a capstone for writing your own PM skill.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Product discovery to PRD for PMs. /pm:scout researches public sources and picks an opportunity, /pm:prototype builds a clickable flow, /pm:prd writes a repository-grounded PRD with an independent review, /pm:create-skill turns one of your practices into a skill.
